_comment: Tolerated high/critical npm advisories (QG-S2). Only unpatched dev/release tooling (semantic-release, markdownlint-cli2, never shipped in the app runtime). The expiry of 90 days is an assumption (starting value); when it passes, scripts/check-audit.mjs fails so each entry gets re-reviewed: look for a patched release first, then extend with a new reason or remove the entry.

entries.reason: braces <=3.0.3 has no patched release (latest 3.0.3; micromatch 4.0.8 requires it); pulled in by commit-analyzer, markdownlint-cli2 and semantic-release, dev tooling only.
http-cache-semantics <=4.2.0 has no patched release (latest 4.2.0); inside the npm CLI bundled by @semantic-release/npm (latest 13.2.0), release tooling only.
brace-expansion 5.0.9 (patched 5.0.12) is frozen inside the npm CLI bundled by @semantic-release/npm 13.2.0 (via minimatch); not fixable without a major downgrade, release tooling only.
Same bundled npm CLI copy of brace-expansion 5.0.9 as GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7; release tooling only.

undici 6.28.0 (patched 6.28.1) is frozen inside the npm CLI bundled by @semantic-release/npm 13.2.0 (via node-gyp); release tooling only. The ip-address advisories (via socks, same bundle) are moderate and need no entry.
